mapper.update: UPDATE pisces_event_replay_job SET job_status = 'FAILED', active_key = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND job_status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND started_at < #{staleBefore}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO pisces_event_replay_job (replay_job_id, experiment_id, operator, job_status, active_key, replay_mode, scope_start_time, scope_end_time, event_types_json, include_events, include_exposures, full_derived_replay, planned_affected_count, planned_event_count, planned_exposure_count, planned_group_count, affected_count, event_count, exposure_count, group_count, mab_reward_count, error_message, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{entity.replayJobId}, #{entity.experimentId}, #{entity.operator}, #{entity.jobStatus}, #{entity.activeKey}, #{entity.replayMode}, #{entity.scopeStartTime}, #{entity.scopeEndTime}, #{entity.eventTypesJson}, #{entity.includeEvents}, #{entity.includeExposures}, #{entity.fullDerivedReplay}, #{entity.plannedAffectedCount}, #{entity.plannedEventCount}, #{entity.plannedExposureCount}, #{entity.plannedGroupCount}, #{entity.affectedCount}, #{entity.eventCount}, #{entity.exposureCount}, #{entity.groupCount}, #{entity.mabRewardCount}, #{entity.errorMessage}, #{entity.startedAt}, #{entity.finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, replay_job_id, experiment_id, operator, job_status, active_key, replay_mode, scope_start_time, scope_end_time, event_types_json, include_events, include_exposures, full_derived_replay, planned_affected_count, planned_event_count, planned_exposure_count, planned_group_count, affected_count, event_count, exposure_count, group_count, mab_reward_count, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_event_replay_job WHERE experiment_id = #{experimentId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, replay_job_id, experiment_id, operator, job_status, active_key, replay_mode, scope_start_time, scope_end_time, event_types_json, include_events, include_exposures, full_derived_replay, planned_affected_count, planned_event_count, planned_exposure_count, planned_group_count, affected_count, event_count, exposure_count, group_count, mab_reward_count, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_event_replay_job WHERE experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND replay_job_id = #{replayJobId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pisces_event_replay_job SET affected_count = #{affectedCount}, event_count = #{eventCount}, exposure_count = #{exposureCount}, group_count = #{groupCount}, mab_reward_count = #{mabRewardCount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE replay_job_id = #{replayJobId} AND job_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE pisces_event_replay_job SET job_status = 'SUCCEEDED', active_key = NULL, affected_count = #{affectedCount}, event_count = #{eventCount}, exposure_count = #{exposureCount}, group_count = #{groupCount}, mab_reward_count = #{mabRewardCount}, error_message = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE replay_job_id = #{replayJobId} AND job_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE pisces_event_replay_job SET job_status = 'FAILED', active_key = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE replay_job_id = #{replayJobId} AND job_status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')
UPDATE pisces_event_replay_job SET job_status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE replay_job_id = #{replayJobId} AND job_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE pisces_event_replay_job SET job_status = 'CANCELLED', active_key = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE replay_job_id = #{replayJobId} AND job_status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')
